constant 4 bohr, two valence electrons, unpolarized LDA_X plus VWN5, local GTH). A PySCF execution/validation workflow. Eleven settings separately compare k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF; Gamma and 2³ are compared with independent DFTK plane waves. Equilibrium helium, complete-basis, metals and general materials remain unvalidated. Fixed one-atom simple-cubic He cell (lattice constant 4 bohr, two valence electrons, unpolarized LDA_X plus VWN5, local GTH). A PySCF execution/validation workflow. Eleven settings separately compare k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF; Gamma and 2³ are compared with independent DFTK plane waves. Equilibrium helium, complete-basis, metals and general materials remain unvalidated. Equations, figures and error analysis · Code ZIP for this example AssumptionsFixed neutral two-electron closed-shell cell with integer occupations. Explicit Gamma-centered fractional k coordinates and equal weights. Independent DFTK uses identical GTH coefficients and Libxc functionals; no fitted energy shifts.UnitsAtomic units: distances in bohr, energies in hartree per primitive cell and wavevectors in inverse bohr. Fractional k coordinates use reciprocal-lattice units.Boundaries and model scopeThree-dimensional Bloch periodic boundaries. One He atom and two valence electrons per neutral primitive cell, including the ionic Ewald term.
